checks.rationale: AC1 and AC2 pass: one plan-qualified namespace, exact membership/edges and acceptance coverage, cycle rejection, deterministic order, and accepted-integrated direct-dependency frontier.

REQ-03/AC-03 and ADR-001 through ADR-005 are respected. Pure flat planning behavior uses frozen accepted contracts; state, scheduling, recovery, isolation attestation and adapters remain separately owned.

Full source trace agrees with an exhaustive permutation oracle for all 64 directed three-node graphs: 25 valid DAGs and 39 cycle rejections. Thirty-two shuffled five-node DAGs and 1,024 fact subsets produce correct deterministic order and readiness with exact direct facts.

Fourteen schema/membership/edge/digest failures return immutable structured domain errors. Invalid, unknown, foreign and duplicate accepted facts fail closed; OID syntax is checked. Pure graph computation acquires no resources or runtime IO requiring cleanup.

Qualified lookup separates repeated local IDs. All 11 non-superseded statuses obey frontier rules; accepted/completed status alone never unlocks a dependent. Proposed replacement topology retains completed prerequisites and remaps successors; superseded and archived live inputs reject separately. Contracts require live topology, not loading excluded history.

Declared suite ran 13 tests, exit 0, with the required interpreter and candidate-local module origins. Independent suite ran 10 tests, exit 0, using permutation and set-based expectations plus negative and immutable-value checks. Nonzero counts were observed; Windows execution is recorded without an unrun Linux claim.

Only three declared owned additions, with accepted TASK-001/TASK-004 prerequisites. Recomputed 39-task structural digest matches approved r4 isolation; no scope, shared contract or dependency expansion.

Verified actual root base, candidate head/merge-base/cleanliness, raw binary diff, all 13 committed context hashes, validation hash, raw policy/model digest and canonical fingerprint. Exact diff has only source, owned tests and handoff additions; no deletions, renames or unrelated changes.

Explicit typed builder and immutable graph/node/coverage/fact/frontier values reuse accepted registry, digest, identity, enum and error implementations. Public imports remain flat and task-owned, with no central exports or duplicate contract layer.

Qualified identities, offline strict schemas, immutable snapshots and full OID validation preserve the pure boundary. Accepted-integration objects are supplied factual attestations; this module does not observe Git or infer authorization. Native reviewer/implementer submission provenance and unavailable provider confirmation are recorded honestly.

Owned handoff accurately documents both ACs, public interfaces, topology/digest/coverage semantics, required integrated facts, actual implementation validation and downstream ownership. Review distinguishes its historical dispatch base from the exact current merged review base.
